name: Parameterized Hopper tma load method
summary: Use Hopper TMA load wrappers, selecting a supported tensor rank.

strategy.intent: Map GEMM arithmetic to architecture-native Tensor Core instructions.
strategy.mechanism: Issue an asynchronous Hopper TMA load using a CUtensorMap descriptor instead of per-thread global-memory address calculations.
strategy.expected_benefit: Uses the GPU matrix-multiply datapath instead of scalar arithmetic.
tradeoffs: Requires compatible fragment layouts, data types, alignment, and architecture support.

constraints.rationale: TMA is a Hopper data-movement facility.
TMA instructions consume a tensor-map descriptor.
Descriptor coordinates and destination layout must agree.
Consumers wait for TMA load completion through an mbarrier.
